title: Salvia officinalis tea for medicinal use
intro: Salvia officinalis tea is a herbal infusion made from the leaves of the common sage plant. It has been used for centuries in traditional herbalism for its various health benefits. This tea is often consumed to support respiratory health, reduce inflammation, and promote mental clarity. It is also used in aromatherapy to help alleviate stress and improve focus. In herbal medicine, it is valued for its antimicrobial and antioxidant properties.
